skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 900% ATK DMG to all targets in a row with 3 consecutive hits. Increases the team’s Block Rate by 30% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 1200% ATK DMG to all targets in a row with 3 consecutive hits. Increases the team’s Block Rate by 40% for 2 turns. Additionally increases the team’s Block by 40% for 2 turns.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Child Emperor gains 60% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. All allies gain the following effect: after triggering a Block, receives [Tenacity] equal to 25% of Max HP. Can trigger up to 4 times. [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]: The reduction applies to all types of DMG and does not stack with [Agility].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Child Emperor gains 70% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. All allies gain the following effect: after triggering a Block, receives [Tenacity] equal to 30% of Max HP. Can trigger up to 4 times. [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]: The reduction applies to all types of DMG and does not stack with [Agility].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Child Emperor gains 80% [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]. All allies gain the following effect: after triggering a Block, receives [Tenacity] equal to 35% of Max HP. Can trigger up to 4 times. [Non-Crit DMG Reduction]: The reduction applies to all types of DMG and does not stack with [Agility].

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: Basic Core: Gains 3 Energy each turn. Advanced Core: Upon entering battle, all allies permanently gain [Specialized Resilience]. Before the start of each turn, all allies receive [Tenacity] equal to 100% of their Max HP, unaffected by Shield Rate. After battle begins, removes enemy buffs that increase or decrease DMG during battle. [Specialized Resilience]: Grants a shield that absorbs all types of DMG, with a maximum capacity equal to 5 times the character’s Max HP. Each Shield point can absorb 10 DMG, and [Tenacity] can recharge the shield.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: Gains 3 Energy each turn. After any character triggers a Block, gains 1 Energy. Can trigger once per turn.

skills.name: Awaken 3 Passive
skills.desc: Gains 3 Energy each turn. After any character triggers a Block, gains 1 Energy. Can trigger once per turn. The entire team gains a 20% DMG boost to all types of DMG for 2 turns.

effects.desc: The shield absorbs damage up to a portion of the subject's Health; Charge DMG ignores it.
Reduces all non-critical damage (usually to 1). Cannot survive and avoid Agility.
Evasion type buff; mutually exclusive with Non-Crit Damage Immunity.
The absorption barrier, usually created from transmogrified damage, absorbs damage before health is affected.
